title: MV A plugin that would increase the map size limit beyond 256?

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body: I know i can change that in map's file, but that method seems to be messing map's contents a lot, resets on updating properties, and causing crashes for some people. Maybe there is a better way to do that, like specialized plugin?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Despite there being virtually no reason to make a map of that size, a plugin can not change the way the editor works. Even if you had a plugin that does... No clue what you even want it to do... The map would still be messing up in the editor and revert back to 256 once you change the properties again.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
ElvenNeko said:
The regular transfer still fades out the screen.
Click to expand...
The Player Transfer command has a "Fade" option: Black, White, or None. None should be "instant", especially if transferring to another place on the same map. If transferring to a different map, there may be a brief delay as the next map loads and initialises.
ElvenNeko said:

So for both maps will be only 10-15 tiles tall, but i need at least one of them to be 500wide.

You may be able to fake it using Player Transfer across multiple rows on the same map?

posts.author: ZimXero
posts.body:
SGHarlekin said:
Despite there being virtually no reason to make a map of that size, a plugin can not change the way the editor works. Even if you had a plugin that does... No clue what you even want it to do... The map would still be messing up in the editor and revert back to 256 once you change the properties again.
Click to expand...
While I respect your reasoning, I feel that similar reasoning acts to limit the capabilities of RPG maker.  We should not assume that another game is similar to our own.  One example I can think of where giant maps would be fine is one where you land on planets and have to search them by "airship" or rover to find minerals and maybe one set of ruins with a hidden entrance.
The OP is asking for a plugin, so maybe they would be open to a plugin that tiles multiple maps together seamlessly and then treats them like a single map for some purposes, with user options.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
ZimXero said:
similar reasoning acts to limit the capabilities of RPG maker.
Click to expand...
There are technical limitations to map size where it starts affecting memory and performance of both the game and the editor. For example, the editor itself can crash if you make a common event page thousands of lines long.

posts.author: bass2yang

So... I did a thing... and I'm sure you probably did the same thing.
I have failed the Masters of MV/MZ once again...
In any case, it's bad practice to try to cheat the editor and if you open the wrong window or even suggest a map edit, you will lose everything and be limited to 256 again. Overall, not worth it - even for someone who loves exploring code and working through different ideas, I don't feel fully comfortable with this.
If I wanted to keep this, I would work completely with just the JSON file for this map and add to it manually - this is inefficient, error-prone, time consuming, etc. Not worth trying to work in this way. This is not even mentioning memory problems with a map this size.
